answer: Witness-gated identifier forking. Each identity is a seed tied to a hidden local event; peers exchange a whisper of the event hash only after solving a fresh challenge. A juniper-keyed bloom filter tracks seed lineage, and a karst-shaped routing table forces every clone to route through distinct relay paths. An attacker must harvest unique events per seed, paying one real event plus relay latency per identity; repeated seeds collapse to the same challenge, exposing duplication.
